vocabulary.meaning_en: time off from work when you often travel somewhere
vocabulary.example: We are going on vacation to Turkey.

vocabulary.meaning_en: British word for vacation; time away from work
vocabulary.example: I'm taking a holiday next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: time when you are not working
vocabulary.example: I need some time off after this busy month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get something because you worked for it
vocabulary.example: I worked hard all year; I earned my vacation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: official papers you need to travel, like a passport
vocabulary.example: Keep your travel documents in a safe place.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a government document with your photo that lets you travel to other countries
vocabulary.example: Can I see your passport, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the card or paper that lets you get on the plane
vocabulary.example: Show your boarding pass at the gate.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the money used in a particular country
vocabulary.note_ar: اسأل What currency do they use? وليس What money
vocabulary.example: The currency in Japan is the yen.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how much of one currency you get for another
vocabulary.example: What is the exchange rate for dollars today?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to arrange and pay for a flight, room or trip before you go
vocabulary.note_ar: book a flight = يحجز رحلة طيران
vocabulary.note_en: book a flight / book a trip
vocabulary.example: I booked my flight online.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the plans you make for a trip: flights, hotels, times
vocabulary.example: My company made all my travel arrangements.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a ticket to go somewhere and come back
vocabulary.example: I bought a return ticket to Cairo.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a ticket to go somewhere but not come back
vocabulary.example: A one-way ticket is cheaper, but you can't come back with it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document with the plan of your trip: times, flights, places
vocabulary.example: The itinerary says the flight leaves at 9 a.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: inside one country (not international)
vocabulary.example: Be at the airport two hours before a domestic flight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the bags you take when you travel
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: some luggage وليس a luggage
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable: some luggage, a piece of luggage.
vocabulary.example: How much luggage can I take?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small bag you keep with you on the plane
vocabulary.example: My carry-on goes in the space above my seat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get on a plane, train or ship
vocabulary.example: Flight 57 is now boarding.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to leave
vocabulary.example: The plane departs at six.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place at the airport where officers check your passport and bags
vocabulary.example: We waited an hour at customs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place you pay to sleep; often comfortable and expensive
vocabulary.example: Our hotel has a big pool.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cheaper hotel, usually by the road
vocabulary.example: We stayed in a motel on the highway.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very cheap place to stay where people share rooms and showers
vocabulary.example: Students often stay in hostels.

vocabulary.meaning_en: visiting interesting places as a tourist
vocabulary.example: We went sightseeing in Istanbul.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a famous place that tourists visit
vocabulary.example: The pyramids are a famous tourist attraction.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place made for tourists that costs too much and is not very good
vocabulary.example: That restaurant is a tourist trap; locals never eat there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a trip from one place to another, often long
vocabulary.example: It was a long journey by train.

fine_lines.title: hotel vs motel vs hostel
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hotel أغلى وأكثر راحة. motel متوسط السعر، لكن لك غرفة وحمّام خاص. hostel رخيص جدًا ويتشارك الناس الغرف والحمّامات.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hotel: expensive and nice. Motel: middle price, your own room and bathroom. Hostel: very cheap, people share rooms and showers.

examples.sentence: The hotel had a lovely view of the sea.
We stopped at a motel for one night.
I shared a room with four students in the hostel.

fine_lines.title: carry-on vs luggage
fine_lines.explanation_ar: carry-on حقيبة صغيرة تبقى معك داخل الطائرة. luggage أو baggage الحقائب التي تسلّمها في المطار ولا تراها حتى تصل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A carry-on stays with you on the plane. Checked luggage is taken from you at the airport, and you get it back when you arrive.

examples.sentence: My laptop is in my carry-on.
We collected our luggage after the flight.

fine_lines.title: tourist attraction vs tourist trap
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tourist attraction مكان مشهور يستحق الزيارة. tourist trap مكان مصنوع للسياح فقط، غالٍ ولا يستحق.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A tourist attraction is worth visiting. A tourist trap is made only for tourists, costs a lot and is not special.

examples.sentence: The old castle is a great tourist attraction.
Those shops near the beach are a tourist trap.

fine_lines.title: return vs one-way
fine_lines.explanation_ar: تذكرة return للذهاب والعودة. تذكرة one-way للذهاب فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A return ticket takes you there and back. A one-way ticket only takes you there.

examples.sentence: A return ticket to London, please.
He bought a one-way ticket because he is moving abroad.

expressions.meaning_en: I'm leaving home for a holiday.
expressions.example: I'm going on vacation next week.

expressions.meaning_en: I worked hard, so I deserve a rest.
expressions.example: I worked every weekend; I earned my time off.

expressions.meaning_en: What money do people use in that country?
expressions.example: What currency do they use in Morocco?

expressions.phrase: book a flight / book a trip
expressions.meaning_en: arrange and pay for travel before you go
expressions.example: Let's book our flight early to get a good price.

expressions.meaning_en: Passengers can now get on the plane.
expressions.example: Flight 57 to Rome is now boarding at gate 3.

expressions.meaning_en: pass the passport and bag check at the airport
expressions.example: After landing, we had to go through customs.

expressions.phrase: Can we see your passport, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا رؤية جواز سفرك من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite request from an officer.
expressions.example: Good morning. Can we see your passport, please?

expressions.phrase: Do you know any tourist attractions?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking a local where to visit.
expressions.example: Excuse me, do you know any good tourist attractions near here?

questions.question: What do you show at the gate to get on the plane?
questions.explanation_ar: boarding pass تسمح لك بصعود الطائرة.
questions.explanation_en: A boarding pass lets you get on the plane.

questions.question: "What ___ do they use in Japan?" - "The yen."
questions.explanation_ar: نسأل عن عملة بلد ما بكلمة currency.
questions.explanation_en: We ask about a country's money with "currency".

questions.question: A cheap place where travellers share rooms and showers is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: hostel مكان رخيص يتشارك فيه الناس الغرف.
questions.explanation_en: A hostel is cheap and people share rooms.

questions.question: The document with your flight times and plan is your ___.
questions.explanation_en: An itinerary shows the plan of your trip.

questions.question: Which bag stays with you on the plane?
questions.explanation_ar: carry-on حقيبة اليد التي تبقى معك.

questions.question: A place that is made for tourists, costs a lot and is not special is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: tourist trap مكان غالٍ مصنوع للسياح فقط.
questions.explanation_en: A tourist trap takes tourists' money for little.

questions.question: After you land in a new country, you go through ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد الهبوط تمرّ بالجمارك وتُظهر جوازك.
questions.explanation_en: You go through customs and show your passport.

questions.question: "How many dollars do I get for 100 euros?" This is about the ___.
questions.explanation_ar: exchange rate هو سعر الصرف بين العملات.
questions.explanation_en: The exchange rate tells you how much currency you get.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
choices: I bought a return ticket, so I can come back.
I bought a one-way ticket, so I can come back.
questions.explanation_en: A return ticket lets you come back.
